about.heading: System Identity
about.intro: Frontend developer with experience building workflow automation tools, production-grade applications, and scalable user interfaces using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern frontend technologies.
paragraphs: I specialize in building systems that think in flows. My experience includes developing interactive workflow diagrams using React Flow, building production-grade Next.js applications, and creating reusable component libraries.

At Hridayam Soft Solutions, I worked on a Collection System production project using Next.js and Ant Design, integrating REST APIs with Laravel backend and PostgreSQL database. I also developed reusable internal npm modules.
I completed a 6-month Full Stack Development Bootcamp through upGrad, and I hold a Master of Computer Applications degree from Chandigarh University with a CGPA of 7.48/10.
